title: External step harness vs. model capacity (d_scratch, n_layers)
question: Because cls and step_ar offload inter-column state updates (rewriting c_k and stripping transient tokens) to the external harness while ar must track the entire unrolled trace in context, can cls and step_ar solve base-conditioned addition with a smaller working-memory scratchpad (d_scratch) or fewer layers (n_layers) than ar?
